honeypotDescription: Catch spam bots with a channel no member has a reason to write in.
setupDescription: Make a channel the honeypot: who writes there is caught. I create the channel when none is given.
disableDescription: Stop catching who writes in the honeypot channel.
showDescription: Show how the honeypot is set up.
optionsChannelDescription: The channel that becomes the honeypot, a new one when omitted.
optionsActionDescription: What I do to who writes in the channel, a softban unless you choose.
optionsLogsDescription: The channel I report every catch to.
optionsDirectMessageDescription: Whether I tell who is caught why, in a direct message.
optionsWarningDescription: Whether I keep a message in the channel that warns the members not to write there.
optionsRandomNameDescription: Whether I give the channel another name every day.
optionsKeepActiveDescription: Whether I send a message to the channel every day, so it does not look abandoned.
optionsForwardMessageDescription: Whether I forward the message to the logs channel before I delete it.
optionsTimeoutFirstDescription: Whether I time the member out for an hour before a softban or a ban.
optionsRecentDeleteDescription: Whether a softban or a ban deletes the last 15 minutes instead of the last hour.
optionsChaosNameDescription: Whether the daily name of the channel is random characters instead of one of my list.
optionsEnsureDeletionDescription: Whether I delete what the member left in the channels two minutes after the action.

channelUnknown: I could not find that channel in this server.

menuLogsSameChannel: The catches cannot be reported to the honeypot channel itself, choose another channel to report them to.

setupCreated: {{GREENTICK}} I created {{channel}} and made it the honeypot channel: I act on whoever writes there, but the moderators. Move it where the bots will find it, the top of the list works best.

editNothing: Tell me what to change with at least one option.
notSetUp: The honeypot is not set up. Set it up with {{command}}.
disabled: {{GREENTICK}} {{channel}} is no longer a honeypot channel, nobody is caught for writing there. I did not delete it.
showOff: The honeypot is off, nobody is caught. Set it up with {{command}}.
noticeTitle: Do not write in this channel
noticeDescription: This channel is a trap for spam bots and hacked accounts, no member has a reason to write here.
noticeKick: Whoever does is kicked from the server at once.
noticeSoftban: Whoever does is removed from the server at once, and what they sent lately is deleted.
noticeBan: Whoever does is banned from the server at once.

intro:
## 👋 Welcome to the honeypot channel
- Whoever writes here is caught: the message is deleted and the action of `/honeypot` is taken on them. The moderators are never caught, so you can test it.
- **Tips to catch more:**
  - Give the channel a name of its own, such as `#{{name}}`, so the bots cannot avoid it by its name; `/honeypot edit random-name:True` does it every day.
  - Keep it near the top of the list: the bots write in the first channels they find.
  - Keep my highest role above the roles the members give themselves, so I can act on all of them.
- `/honeypot show` lists the settings and tells what keeps the trap from working.
problemsTitle: ⚠️ Some things keep the honeypot from catching:
problemEveryoneCannotView: `@everyone` cannot see the channel, so the bots cannot either: nobody is caught.
problemEveryoneCannotSend: `@everyone` cannot write in the channel, so the bots cannot either: nobody is caught.
problemEveryoneCannotAttach: `@everyone` cannot attach files in the channel, and many spam bots post an image: they are not caught.
problemBotCannotAct: I lack what the action needs: check my permissions and that my highest role is above the ones of the members.
problemBigRoleAboveBot: A role most of the members hold is above my highest role, so I cannot act on them: move my role above it.
optionsReinviteDescription: Include a one-use, 24-hour invite in the direct message after a kick or softban.
optionsRecreateDescription: Replace each honeypot channel daily. Its messages are deleted.
reinviteMessage: You can rejoin the server using this invite: {{url}}
